name: wafc-analysis-workstation-portable
description: Portable WAFC case, task and Field Collector result review workstation

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @wafc/domain build && pnpm --filter @wafc/evidence-repository build && pnpm --filter @wafc/workstation-core build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:collector: cargo fmt --manifest-path ../FieldCollector/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path ../FieldCollector/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path ../FieldCollector/Cargo.toml --locked && pnpm --dir ../FieldCollector test
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:collector && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.package:portable: pnpm run check && pnpm run build:collector && pnpm run stage:collector && node scripts/build-portable.mjs
